name: Pastel Surreal Psychological Collage
description: A restrained matte mixed-media collage language for symbolic psychological subjects and editorial emotional imagery.
style_bible: Build a matte mixed-media psychological collage with painterly and sculptural traces, subtle grain, restrained blur or erosion, and strong low-saturation figure-ground separation. Work from dusty peach, mauve, lavender, pale blue, cream, charcoal, and warm gray; use ember orange only as a restrained accent. Favor fragmented, eroded or doubled forms, mask-like shapes, silhouettes, shallow relief, and abstract emotional shapes. Keep the atmosphere sparse, tactile, and psychologically suggestive rather than literal.
negative_prompt: Reject glossy CGI, photoreal stock imagery, neon color, crowded scenes, tiny typography, logos, watermarks, copied trade dress, malformed anatomy, and malformed text.
